fuel.notes: Cool, mixed sun and clouds. Started in sun hoody, switched to short sleeves pretty quickly. Shorts, akashas. Knee taped, didn't hurt until mile 7 or 10 or something. Brought 1500 ml, filtered an additional 500 at bear creek and refilled again at Eben B Fine. I wish I could remember how much. I would guess my total consumption was between 3000 and 3500 ml. Had skratch in one, could have used more. Feet hurt towards end of day. Ate 4 maple syrup tubes, 4 honey stinger packets, 1 gu waffle, two servings of gummies (200 cal), one nut bar, one epic bar. Just about 1000 cals for the day, which is more than 100 cals every 45 minutes. Was hungry early on, had coffee+half a pb and j on euro bread+ a banana for breakfast. Took 3 ibuprofen before going up sanitas.

Cool, overcast, rainy day.  Shorts, akashas. Brought 1500 ml drank ~1400. Ate 2 honey stinger gels, one maple tube, one serving of TJ's gummies, and one mapleaid drink mix packet for salt. That made me slightly naseauous for a moment. Just about 100 cals every 45 minutes except for the extra mapleaid cals. Didn't feel hungry until downhill, but then felt hungry for real food on the long downhill. Had coffee+full pb & j for breakfast. Skratch in one of my bottles, could have used more. Sun hoody+t shirt+houdini, never wore houdini despite rain, glad for sun hoody when it got chillier. 59 at car but hot on trail in the sun. Taped knee, hurt from get go especially on non-steppy uphill.

Hot, sunny. Started at 7:10, took off shirt after flatiron. Too hot. Brought 1500 ml, drank that plus refilled 700-800ml at Bear Creek for total of 230ish. Ate 3 honey stinger gels, 1.5 servings of TJ's gummies, one mapleaid drink mix packet, two scoops skratch, some almonds, half a cliff bar. Total of 850-ish calories for for 188 calories an hour. Never felt hungry or bonked, was glad I brought the bar after all. Taped right knee but tape was coming off by the end. Probably still helped, knee wasn't too bad. Mutants slapped and so did rabbit shorts. Really the whole kit worked well. Need to remember TAPE and more sunscreen for body. Ate rest of half cliff bar and drank a double dose of non-sugared electrolytes with lots of water. Then ate a burrito. Still have a bad headache. Not sure what to do about that.

Cold and windy. Wore shorts, brought pants and put them on around 12500 ft. 90 degrees in boulder but that didn't translate to the alpine until we were back down below treeline, then it was hot. Would have liked a puffy. Had a vest, houdini, and gloves (the latter were essential). Stuck to about 100 cals every 45 minutes. Pickles were great. Tried to stay hydrated despite cold, slight headache but not too bad. Right knee taped, hurt a bit on downhill. Fatigued from a double hitter weekend. Pack too small and my poles rub on my lower back.

Bringing: 200 cals of gummies, 1 gu waffles, 2 maple syrup tubes, 2 honey stinger packets, one giant slice of pizza, one skratch packet, one mapleade packet. Including tailwind and skratch in water to start with (200cals)  that's 1140calories of sugar+one giant slice of pizza=1540 calories for the day. Doubt I'lll eat all of it. Throwing in a bar just in case I can't keep the pizza down so thats 1940. 100 cals every 45 minutes and an estimated 8 hours=1066 calories. \n\nUpdate after the fact: ended up taking 11 hours instead of 8, lol. Ate everything except one gel and one maple syrup tube, so 200 cals. 100 cals every 45 minutes for 11 hours is 1466 cals and I ate 1740, so a bit more than expected. 188 cals/45 min. good beta. I did feel hungry at several points and was grateful to have real food (pizza and a pro bar). Even though the tailwind/skratch/etc is calories it doesn't fill my stomach. Would have been less hungry if I'd been moving faster. On a longer push will certainly need solid food to keep from bonking. Got a mild headache towards end of the day, mapleaid tube (salt!!!) and ibuprofen helped. Thinking on longer run will just need to take planned ibuprofen. Or maybe a knee brace? Need to remember to reapply sunscreen. Both knees sore by end of day, was easier to go faster on the downhill on good trail than slower. Rolled R ankle once, slightly sore day after. Knees don't hurt day after. Ate a massive turkey sandwich for dinner which I think was key for recovery. Feel like I could go again tomorrow. Wore mutants, running tights, sun hoody, hat (that won't stay on in the wind), houdini for most of it when above treeline, brought gloves and wore them on/off. Wore tights+sun hoody below treeline. Very warm when the wind wasn't blowing, which it usually was. Put puffy on once during a food break. Other than it being hard to get my poles into the pack when I'm wearing it (and it was nice to have poles for steep up/down) the distance 15 was perfect. Oh lastly, water: brought 2 liters of capacity in 500 ml flasks. Drank 1 liter on the way up to thunder lake, refilled there, had 2 full liters heading up the divide. Definitely felt a little pressed for water on the divide, ellie says she saw a pool between tamina and the cleaver but I missed it. Or maybe on the way to isolation? I should ask. Descended and refilled all my bottles. Drank all but 500 ml by the time we were to the car. So total consumption for the day was 1 liter+2 liters+1.5 liters=4.5 liters. Peed clear the whole day. .4 liters an hour, also good beta.
